key_events: Teen skateboarder crashes onto Saul’s windshield, shattering it
Teen feigns injury and screams for money
Friend records the extortion attempt with a smartphone
Saul erupts in rage, kicks the teen’s supposedly broken knee
Saul declares he’s a lawyer, mocking the scam
Scammer kids flee in panic with their skateboards
Saul shouts after them, demanding a check
narrative_context.cultural_context: Street-level accident scams amplified by smartphone recording; heat intensifies tempers; public confrontation flips power dynamics.

characters.name: Saul
characters.description: Older man with intense glare; stands beside a battered yellow compact car with a red door; sunlit sweat; wiry energy; commanding posture.
characters.voice_description: Sharp, sarcastic, loud; mid-aged American; confident, biting delivery.
characters.personality: Blunt, confrontational, perceptive, fearless; refuses victimhood; darkly comedic.
characters.backstory: A seasoned lawyer used to scams; quick to judge and act; distrusts opportunists.
characters.current_motivation: Expose the fake injury, shut down extortion, assert control.

characters.name: Teen Scammer
characters.description: Teenage skateboarder; crashed onto the windshield; scrapes, panicked face; clutching knee on hot asphalt; wiry frame; quick reflexes.
characters.voice_description: High, strained, performative panic; teenage male; local accent.
characters.personality: Opportunistic, deceptive, cowardly; collapses under real threat.
characters.backstory: Small-time scammer staging accidents for cash with a friend.
characters.current_motivation: Feign injury to extort money from Saul.

characters.name: Scammer Friend
characters.description: Teen with smartphone; filming on the sun-baked street; alert eyes; tense posture; ready to bolt with skateboard.
characters.voice_description: Quiet, muttering; nervous teen voice; uncertain bravado.
characters.backstory: Partner in staged accident scheme; handles recording and pressure tactics.
characters.current_motivation: Record evidence to coerce payment; flee when confronted.

locations.name: Sun-baked Street
locations.visual_style: Harsh midday sun, heat shimmer, glare on cracked asphalt; sparse traffic; bleached colors; handheld chaos.
locations.narrative_function: Confrontation space; public stage for scam and reversal.

props.name: Battered Yellow Compact Car
props.visual_description: Small yellow compact car, severely battered bodywork, one mismatched red door; windshield shattered on impact; sun-faded, dusty, neglected.

props.name: Shattered Windshield
props.visual_description: Safety glass spiderwebbed and caved in where the skateboarder landed; jagged shards glinting in bright sun.

props.name: Skateboards
props.visual_description: Two worn street skateboards, scratched decks and chipped edges, black grip tape, standard trucks and wheels.

props.name: Smartphone
props.visual_description: Contemporary smartphone used to film; slim, black case; prominent camera lens.
